searchCriteria.title: 🔍 Search Criteria
searchCriteria.sectionCaption: Define what jobs to search for

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Job title or skill keywords to search for. Leave empty to fetch all jobs.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude Keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Jobs containing these keywords will be excluded.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Filter jobs by country. Leave empty for all countries.

remoteRegions.title: Remote Regions
remoteRegions.description: For remote jobs, filter by allowed regions (e.g., 'EU', 'US', 'Worldwide').

visaFilters.title: 🛂 Visa Sponsorship Filters
visaFilters.sectionCaption: The moat: filter by actual visa sponsorship availability

visaSponsorshipOnly.title: Visa Sponsorship Only
visaSponsorshipOnly.description: Only return jobs where visa sponsorship is likely available (based on official registries and JD analysis).

visaRegistryCountries.title: Visa Registry Countries
visaRegistryCountries.description: Which official sponsor registries to check against.

minVisaConfidence.title: Minimum Visa Confidence
minVisaConfidence.description: Minimum visa confidence level to include in results.

excludeExplicitNoSponsorship.title: Exclude 'No Sponsorship' Jobs
excludeExplicitNoSponsorship.description: Exclude jobs that explicitly state they do NOT offer visa sponsorship.

sources.title: 📡 Data Sources
sources.sectionCaption: Choose which job sources to scrape

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which job sources to fetch from. Leave empty for all.

companyUrls.title: Company Career URLs
companyUrls.description: Specific company career page URLs to scrape. The Actor will auto-detect the ATS and fetch all jobs.

companyNames.title: Company Names
companyNames.description: Company names to search for. The Actor will attempt to find their career pages.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted Within (Days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only include jobs posted within the last N days.

minSalary.title: Minimum Salary
minSalary.description: Minimum salary (in salary currency). Jobs without salary info are still included.

technologies.title: Required Technologies
technologies.description: Only include jobs mentioning these technologies.

aiClassification.title: 🤖 AI Classification (Optional)
aiClassification.sectionCaption: Enable AI-powered relevance scoring and job analysis

enableAIClassification.title: Enable AI Classification
enableAIClassification.description: Use AI to score job relevance, detect AI/ML roles, and analyze job descriptions. Costs extra per job.

minimumRelevanceScore.title: Minimum Relevance Score
minimumRelevanceScore.description: Only include jobs with AI relevance score above this threshold (0.0-1.0). Only applies if AI is enabled.

maxAICalls.title: Max AI Calls Per Run
maxAICalls.description: Budget limit for AI classification calls in this run. Prevents unexpected costs.

classificationPrompt.title: Custom Classification Prompt
classificationPrompt.description: Optional: override the default AI classification prompt with your own criteria.

outputOptions.title: 📦 Output Options
outputOptions.sectionCaption: Control the output format and volume

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

includeDescription.title: Include Full Description
includeDescription.description: Include the full job description text in output. Disable to reduce output size.

includeRawMetadata.title: Include Raw Source Metadata
includeRawMetadata.description: Include source-specific raw metadata in output.

deduplicateWithinRun.title: Deduplicate Within Run
deduplicateWithinRun.description: Remove duplicate jobs across sources within this run.

maxPerSource.title: Max Jobs Per Source
maxPerSource.description: Maximum jobs to fetch from each individual source.

timeoutPerSourceSecs.title: Timeout Per Source (seconds)
timeoutPerSourceSecs.description: Maximum time to wait for each source before skipping it.

maxRuntimeSecs.title: Max Runtime (seconds)
maxRuntimeSecs.description: Hard limit on total Actor runtime. Prevents runaway costs.

useBrowserFallback.title: Use Browser Fallback
useBrowserFallback.description: If HTTP API fails, try Playwright browser automation. WARNING: Significantly increases compute cost.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy configuration. Not needed for v1 (all sources are public APIs).
